about_the_game:
Your search begins in a bazaar that never ends… but the loop won’t keep you there.
Each cycle twists reality further, pulling you into new places beyond the market.
You are a lost child, chasing the faint trace of your mother through shifting spaces where nothing feels quite right.

Anomalies seep into the world—small, subtle wrongness that grows the longer you look. Notice what doesn’t belong, survive the loop, and maybe you’ll uncover where it’s trying to take you.
But will you ever find her? Or will the world swallow you first?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of violence, including scenes with blood and dead bodies. Players may witness characters being harmed or killed with weapons such as axes. The visuals are stylized with low-poly, retro PSX-style graphics. There is no sexual content.
